key.name: target-language
key.description: Language code (ISO 639-1) to translate messages into.

key.name: provider-id
key.description: Provider identifier to use for translation (e.g., 'google', 'argos').

key.name: preserve-format
key.description: Whether to attempt HTML-structure preserving translation.

key.name: translate-shortcut
key.description: Shortcut shared by the mail preview and separate message windows. An empty value disables it.

key.name: venv-path
key.description: Path to the Python virtual environment used by translation providers. If empty, use ~/.local/lib/evolution-translate/venv.

key.name: install-on-demand
key.description: Allow automatic download of missing Argos Translate models when needed.
